<!-- examsstudio-v1:  -->
```{r data, include=FALSE}
exams::initialize_exercise()
.fmt <- function(x, digits = 2) exams::fmt(x, digits = digits, decimal.mark = ",", big.mark = ".")
.locale <- "EU"
.ok <- FALSE
for (.try in seq_len(10000L)) {
  a <- sample(seq(4, 12, by = 1), 1)
  b <- sample(seq(2, 9, by = 1), 1)
  sol <- a + b
  if (isTRUE(a > b)) { .ok <- TRUE; break }
}
if (!.ok) stop("Keine gueltige Variablenkombination gefunden.")

```

Question
========
Berechnen Sie $`r .fmt(a, 0)` + `r .fmt(b, 0)`$.

`r exams::add_cloze(sol, tolerance = 0, digits = 0)`

Answerlist
----------
`r exams::format_metainfo("answerlist")`

Solution
========
Addieren Sie die beiden Zahlen: $`r .fmt(a, 0)` + `r .fmt(b, 0)` = `r .fmt(sol, 0)`$.
